title: Supply scoped values through a custom cascading attribute
goal: Select multiple same-typed scoped component values with a custom attribute when named cascades are insufficient. Framework integration seam; retain explicit notification and disposal ownership.

packageAssets: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components and Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web from the matching shared framework; no external NuGet dependencies or native assets.
platforms: Portable managed renderer harness; Windows x64 execution verified. No native SDK, service account or optional workload.
renderingModes: In-process HtmlRenderer execution; retained HTML output updated on its dispatcher. No browser transport or cross-render-mode execution claimed.
prerequisites: Use the complete project, model, Razor components and Program below. AddLogging supplies HtmlRenderer; the harness does not start a web host.
ASP.NET Core 10 named cascades / typed adapters remain valid comparisons, not a second catalogue edition or a newer API route on net10.0.
constraints: Only CollectionContext properties on IArchiveSubscriber components are supported; reject unknown collection names and other property types.
Mutate the same context object and dispatch notifications on the owning renderer. RefreshArchiveAsync rerenders it; no replacement-value or SetParametersAsync/lifecycle replay contract is provided.
Remove children through the renderer; custom subscriptions unsubscribe once. Dispose the DI scope after its renderer to clean subscriptions still active at full renderer teardown.

ComponentState is a framework implementation seam. Actual RC2 access emits no BL0006; a RenderTree.Renderer control does. No suppression, ExperimentalAttribute opt-in, thread-safety, trimming or NativeAOT guarantee.
stabilityLimitations: Actual evidence: .NET 10.0.13 / SDK 10.0.402 and .NET 11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105 / SDK 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105. GA reconciliation and comprehensive publication gates remain open.
Custom supplier is public but accepts framework-facing ComponentState; analyzer silence does not promise compatibility.

evidence.scope: Real HtmlRenderer execution: attribute/named selection, independent DI scopes and rendered updates; current custom subscriptions dispose once on child removal and scoped teardown fallback.
